stories.title: Create RSS/Atom feed at /feed.xml with Article schema serialization
stories.description: Implement Atom 1.0 feed endpoint for blog posts with proper Article metadata, enabling feed readers and aggregators to discover and syndicate travel content to broader audiences.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /feed.xml returns valid Atom 1.0 XML feed with Content-Type: application/atom+xml; charset=utf-8
Each blog post serialized with title, summary excerpt, published timestamp, author name, and full HTML content in <content type="html">
Feed includes article:published_time and article:author attributes compatible with social media rich previews
technicalNotes: File to create: app/feed.xml/route.ts (generateAtomFeed function handling GET request, ~100 lines)
File to create: lib/blog-feed.ts (buildFeedEntry, formatAtomDate, escapeXml utilities, ~50 lines)
Import blog posts from existing blog data structure in lib/blog or data/ directory
Test command: npm run build && curl -s http://localhost:3000/feed.xml | head -50

stories.title: Add blog post series linking with sequential "Part X of Y" navigation
stories.description: Enable multi-part blog series with metadata, sequential navigation, and schema.org support for comprehensive guides like "Singapore Work Pass" (3-part series) and "JB Itinerary".
acceptanceCriteria: Blog post frontmatter supports optional series object: {name: string, totalParts: number, currentPart: number}
BlogSeriesNav component renders "Part 2 of 3" badge in post header with previous/next navigation links
Navigation links properly route via Wouter: href={`/blog/${getPreviousPartSlug(series)}`} with proper error handling for missing parts
Build fails with clear error if series data is invalid (currentPart > totalParts, missing adjacent parts)
technicalNotes: File to create: lib/blog-series.ts (validateSeriesOrder function, getPreviousPartSlug, getNextPartSlug, ~70 lines)
File to create: components/BlogSeriesNav.tsx (React component with Tailwind styling and Wouter Link, ~60 lines)
File to modify: app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx (import BlogSeriesNav, render after post title if series exists)
Test command: npm run test -- lib/blog-series.test.ts && npm run build

stories.title: Implement blog post author bio section with schema.org Person markup
stories.description: Add author profile component below blog posts with name, bio, avatar, and social links; emit schema.org Person JSON-LD for search engine knowledge panels and author discovery.
acceptanceCriteria: BlogAuthorBio component renders semantic <aside> with author image (via next/image), name heading, bio text, and social media links (LinkedIn, Twitter, etc.)
Post page emits schema.org Person JSON-LD in <head>: {"@type": "Person", "name", "url", "image", "sameAs": [social_urls]}
Author data stored in lib/blog-authors.ts as const array of {id, name, bio, image, socialLinks} objects; validate author ID at build time
Person schema validates at schema.org JSON-LD validator; no schema errors in Lighthouse audit
technicalNotes: File to create: lib/blog-authors.ts (authors const array with ~20 author objects, getAuthorById function, ~40 lines)
File to create: components/BlogAuthorBio.tsx (React component rendering <aside> with Tailwind, semantic HTML, ~90 lines)
File to modify: app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx (add Person schema in generateMetadata, render <BlogAuthorBio author={post.author} /> below post body)
Test command: npm run test -- components/BlogAuthorBio.test.tsx && npm run build && npm run lighthouse

stories.title: Create /blog/resources page with curated JB/Singapore travel links and ItemList schema
stories.description: New resource hub page grouping external travel websites, transport, accommodation, and dining links by category; emit schema.org ItemList for rich search results.
acceptanceCriteria: Page at app/blog/resources/page.tsx displays resources grouped by 5+ categories: Transport, Dining, Shopping, Accommodation, Immigration
Each resource link rendered as ResourceCard: displays title, description, category badge, and external link with rel="noopener noreferrer"
Page emits schema.org WebPage with ItemList schema containing each link as ListItem with name, url, description, and position attributes
Resources loaded from lib/travel-resources.ts as const TRAVEL_RESOURCES array (~30 curated links); easy to maintain and add new links
technicalNotes: File to create: lib/travel-resources.ts (const TRAVEL_RESOURCES array with {title, description, url, category} objects, ~60 lines)
File to create: app/blog/resources/page.tsx (Next.js page component with generateMetadata, ItemList schema, ~100 lines)
File to create: components/ResourceCard.tsx (reusable card component with Tailwind, ~40 lines)
Test command: npm run build && npm run test -- app/blog/resources/page.test.ts

stories.title: Add blog post difficulty level indicator with semantic badge and build-time validation
stories.description: Classify blog posts as Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced with visual badge on cards and post headers; help backpackers quickly assess guide complexity without reading full post.
acceptanceCriteria: Blog post frontmatter includes optional difficulty: "Beginner" | "Intermediate" | "Advanced" enum field with default "Intermediate"
DifficultyBadge component renders semantic <span role="doc-note" aria-label="Difficulty: {level}"> with Tailwind color: blue (Beginner), yellow (Intermediate), red (Advanced)
Badge displays on blog post card (components/BlogCard.tsx) and post header (app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx); includes icon (🟢/🟡/🔴)
Build validates difficulty enum at collectBlogPosts() time; fails if invalid value provided
technicalNotes: File to create: lib/blog-difficulty.ts (validateDifficulty function, getDifficultyColor helper, difficulty type definition, ~30 lines)
File to create: components/DifficultyBadge.tsx (React component with Tailwind and icon, ~40 lines)
File to modify: app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx (render <DifficultyBadge level={post.difficulty} /> in post header)
Test command: npm run test -- components/DifficultyBadge.test.ts && npm run build
